Anatomy and Physiology of the Pancreas
Th e pancreas (see Figure 16.5) is a large accessory digestive 
gland located behind the stomach and opposite both the duo-
denum and the spleen. Th e pancreas is divided into diﬀ erent
portions: the head, which is the wider portion of the pancreas,
followed by the neck, the body, and the tail.
Th e pancreas has two major functions:
• Exocrine function: Produces enzymes necessary for diges-
tion (see Table 16.2).
• Endocrine function: Produces hormones to regulate the use 
of body fuels, mainly glucose (see Chapter 17).
